title: Cut the Signal
briefing: Identify the jammer protecting a relay site, suppress it and verify the emitter has stopped.

phases.label: Locate
phases.completion_observation: Observe an enemy contact already known to the faction.

phases.label: Suppress
phases.completion_observation: Disable the native jammer unit or complete an authorized CYBER action.

phases.label: Confirm
phases.completion_observation: Host confirms native emission loss for 15 continuous seconds.

native_binding: Jammer contact must bind to a native Unit; the truck model alone cannot emit or jam.
reward_policy: existing accepted reward; one completion award
visibility: faction-known contacts only; no hidden enemy coordinates
reset: cancel on scene generation change; release presentation objects
